heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro — built for high-quality visual content creation across image, video, and multimodal workflows.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a full-bleed dark editorial hero with a subtle orange mesh gradient, precision-line grid overlay, and a layered media collage anchored to the lower-right. Make the hero feel like a premium AI production studio: large H1 centered-left within a compact copy column, with a right-side gallery stack showing 3 output thumbnails and 1 UI shell card. Include a top logo trust strip and small floating capability chips around the media block. Autoplay is not used in the hero; use preview-style visuals with play affordances to signal video capability while keeping performance and B2B credibility high. Brand orange must power both CTAs and key highlights.

blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance
blueprint.metaDescription: Explore ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 for AI image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for AI video generation. Create high-quality visuals, synchronized audio-video, and production-ready content for teams and enterprises.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark editorial hero with precision-line overlays, product chips, and compact output preview strip beneath the copy
sections.designNote: Content-first hero that answers what this is, who it is for, and what to do next. Keep the headline direct and premium, with a short supporting line and a single full-width mobile CTA button labeled Get started. Include visual chips for AI image generation, AI video generation with audio, and enterprise-ready infrastructure.

Place 3-6 recognisable logos in a clean static grid directly after the hero. Because this traffic is warm and proof type is logos, make this an early trust anchor with strong visibility and no marquee motion.

Use a two-stage product story with alternating visual energy. First block: Seedream 4.5 as a tabs-with-preview layout focused on the two click-driving features: high-resolution image generation and advanced editing/composition. Show a large preview panel with prompt-to-image examples, typography-heavy outputs, and identity-preserving edits. Second block: Seedance 1.5 Pro as a split-panel showcase with video thumbnails, play overlays, and audio-video sync cues. Do not use a flat static card grid because each section has many features. Prefer spotlight-plus-grid behavior inside the tabs and a strong visual-first rhythm.

Optional trust-supporting block only if needed for buying confidence. Keep it compact and enterprise-oriented: guided evaluation, demo support, and simplified procurement. Use a restrained icon-list or 3-card grid so it does not compete with product proof.

Use a dark pricing band with two product cards and one clearly emphasized choice path. Keep the CTAs identical and singular: Get started. Since the visitor temperature is warm, this section should feel decisive and conversion-led rather than exploratory. Avoid gray or outlined buttons.

Because there are 5 testimonials, use a 3-card grid with balanced editorial styling and concise pulls from creative and marketing roles. Keep it proof-heavy, not overly chatty. Alternate quote emphasis and company-role labels for credibility.

Close with a centered high-contrast form card and a single strong CTA: Get started. Keep fields minimal and the card visually contained. Mobile CTA must be full-width. This is the final conversion push, so the layout should feel calmer but more decisive than the testimonial section.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with brand/logo presence, large centered headline, short supporting copy, and a minimal bullet-style value list; visually weighted for immediate scanning rather than storytelling.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single high-impact hero followed by a lead-capture block and then stacked product feature sections; content flows vertically with clear breaks and repeated section headers.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Primary conversion card with compact form styling, strong border/box containment, and utilitarian layout; feature content is likely presented in simple content blocks rather than decorative cards.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA-led conversion pattern with a single dominant action in the hero and a secondary lower-funnel CTA in product sections; CTAs should be bold, direct, and repeated sparingly.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module evident; pricing is not part of the reference structure.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer not represented in the provided markup; assume a minimal utility footer if needed.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Mostly text-first layout with optional lightweight brand imagery/logo; no strong media gallery or video module evident in the reference.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked feature sections with a headline, short description, then a list of capability bullets; best suited to progressive disclosure and modular feature exposition.
referenceMap.formPattern: Standalone lead form placed directly beneath the hero in a dedicated card/container, optimized for conversion with hidden fields and simple field stacking.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-focused presentation with no obvious motion system; if animated, it should be restrained and functional rather than decorative.

designStrategy.reasoning: This page is best structured as a high-intent demo-booking landing page for solution-aware buyers evaluating advanced generative AI tools. Since the audience includes professionals and enterprises, the design should lead with credibility and product clarity rather than persuasion-heavy storytelling. The strongest trust cue is logos, so the layout should prioritize a sticky logo/trust strip and keep proof visible early. A split hero works well here because it allows a strong headline and CTA without sacrificing immediate product context. Because the user explicitly requested a dark theme and a video gallery section, the visual direction should feel premium, futuristic, and media-forward, with high contrast and output-focused showcases. The content is technical and medium in volume, so the page should remain balanced: compact hero, clear product sections, one dedicated gallery moment, then pricing, testimonials, and form. This supports conversion without overwhelming the visitor.
